subject: Joint close plan — contract edit owners & turnaround
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Katie Reed <katie@greenbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Joint close plan — contract edit owners & turnaround

Katie — great speaking earlier. Quick recap + next steps from our discovery and the MAP draft attached. High-level: GreenBridge wants predictable latency, strong data controls, and a clear procurement path for a Dedicated instance.

Action items I promised to capture here:
- I attached a first-pass MAP (GB-MAP-Draft-v1.pdf) with proposed milestones and a suggested target close date of 2026-12-10.
- We need to align on who on your side will own legal redlines and their expected turnaround time for the MSA/DPA/SLA milestone.
- On our side: Ben (cc'd) will coordinate commercial terms; our Contracts team will handle legal markups, and I'll be the customer point for procurement and scheduling.

Ask: Please confirm the name/email for your procurement/legal reviewer and an expected redline turnaround (e.g., 3 business days after receiving our draft). If you want, I can share a short redline template we use internally to speed review.

Attachments: GB-MAP-Draft-v1.pdf, redline-guidance.docx

Thanks — speaking plainly so we can lock a credible close plan.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Katie Reed <katie@greenbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Joint close plan — contract edit owners & turnaround

Thanks Lauren — good outline. A few internal clarifications so we all speak with one voice to GreenBridge: 

1) Ownership breakdown (Redwood):
   - Contracts/Legal (Marissa) owns the MSA and DPA redlines and will produce our counter-redline.
   - Commercial (Ben) owns pricing, SLAs in the commercial schedule, and negotiation of termination/credits.
   - AE (Lauren) owns coordinating with the customer's procurement and collecting their redlines into a single thread.

2) Typical turnaround targets we can commit to:
   - Initial legal review & counter-redline from Redwood: 48 business hours after email with specifics (target: 2 business days).
   - Internal coordination on low-risk commercial items: 1 business day.

3) Request for the customer: ask them to send consolidated redlines (one consolidated doc or PDF with comments) and a named procurement contact. That reduces back-and-forth and keeps the MAP milestone on schedule.

I attached a short clause snippet and a suggested SLA language variant (SLA_Standard_2026.pdf) to help speed things up. Marissa — can you confirm you have capacity to review by Wednesday EOD PST if they send redlines tomorrow?

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Katie Reed <katie@greenbridge.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Brian Lee <brian.lee@greenbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Joint close plan — contract edit owners & turnaround

Lauren — thanks for the recap and the MAP. We reviewed internally this morning. Procurement/legal ownership: Brian Lee (cc) will lead procurement and legal intake for GreenBridge.

We can commit to the following from our side:
- Brian estimates we can return consolidated redlines for MSA+DPA within 3 business days after we receive your draft redline.
- We need to review your standard SLA and DPA text before final sign-off — please confirm a link or attach.
- Our realistic internal target close date is 2026-12-15 (we have an internal steering committee on the 12th that will sign off pending wording on data residency and uptime credits).

Dependencies from our side: confirmation of data deletion terms, breach notification windows, and a short runbook for how Redwood handles audit requests. If you can send the standard SLA (and any runbook) today, we'll fold into our review.

Thanks — Katie
Katie Reed
Head of Product Operations | GreenBridge Analytics
katie@greenbridge.com | +1 (617) 555-0123

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Katie Reed <katie@greenbridge.com>, Brian Lee <brian.lee@greenbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Joint close plan — contract edit owners & turnaround

Thanks Katie and Brian — good, that's helpful. Ben/Marissa: please treat this as the official MAP milestone kickoff for legal redlines. 

Immediate asks for our side:
- Marissa: please prepare an MSA+DPA redline set and the SLA_Standard_2026.pdf (I attached Ben's copy) and target an internal turnaround of 48 hours after they send their consolidated redlines. If you need me to escalate to Legal Ops for priority, say the word.
- Ben: I'll update the MAP target close to 2026-12-15 and note the Steering Committee dependency on 2026-12-12. Also adding HubSpot: GB-3472 to the MAP.

Katie — I'll upload the SLA and runbook to the Drive link and send a doc link in the next 30 mins. Expect an email from Marissa once we have the redline ready to share.

Thanks — team aligned.

— Lauren
